summary: Learn CPI and PPI compilation, COICOP weights, index calculations and price validation through Excel exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Price statistics track changes across defined goods and services, while index numbers summarize those changes over time using methods such as Laspeyres. For price statisticians and economic analysts, the course builds practical skills in structuring CPI and PPI baskets and weights, calculating and comparing index methods, and validating price observations, including missing or changed products, with Excel and a supplied dataset.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, classify, calculate, validate or report price data and price indices. It suits entry-level staff and practitioners building a foundation in index compilation.
audience: National Accounts Statisticians using CPI and PPI
prerequisites: Basic arithmetic and spreadsheet familiarity are expected. You do not need prior index-number experience, and programming is not required. Bring a laptop with existing access to Excel.
